claims.claim: Potatoes grown with 30 percent vermicompost in simulated lunar soil matched Earth-soil performance while plants without amendment were severely stunted.
claims.episode_span: Plants grown with 30 percent vermicompost matched Earth-soil performance while those without amendment were severely stunted.
claims.source_title: Potatoes grown in simulated lunar soil match Earth-grown performance
claims.supporting_quote: The researchers found that potato plants grown in regolith simulants containing 30% vermicompost matched the growth and development of plants cultivated in Earth soils.

claims.claim: Webb observed the Andromeda stellar merger system only 47 days after the eruption peak.
claims.episode_span: Webb observed the system 47 days after the eruption peak, the earliest follow-up of such an event.
claims.source_title: NASA Data Clinches First-of-Its-Kind Stellar Merger
claims.supporting_quote: Webb observed Bao only 47 days after the stars’ eruption peaked, the earliest ever follow-up of an event like this.

claims.claim: Apollo data show an average strong-shaking duration of 54 minutes after moonquakes compared with under one minute for shallow crustal earthquakes on Earth.
claims.episode_span: Apollo data show an average strong-shaking duration of 54 minutes compared with under one minute for shallow crustal earthquakes on Earth.
claims.source_title: First lunar-specific ground motion model could guide seismic hazard assessments on moon
claims.supporting_quote: The Apollo records show an average strong-shaking duration of about 54 minutes, compared to typically under a minute for shallow crustal events on Earth.

claims.claim: The Korea Aerospace Administration workshop on numerical models and AI was attended by about 50 researchers.
claims.episode_span: The Korea Aerospace Administration held a workshop on numerical models of astrophysical phenomena and artificial intelligence attended by about 50 researchers from universities and institutes.
claims.source_title: From Lunar Landings to Space Telescopes... Preparing for Space Exploration with AI and Supercomputers
claims.supporting_quote: The Korea Aerospace Administration (KASA) said on Nov. 19 that it had held a workshop on “Exploring Ways to Use Numerical Models of Astrophysical Phenomena and AI” at the KT Human Resources Development Center in Daejeon, attended by about 50 people, including researchers from universities and research institutes.

claims.claim: Twelve Tufts students attended the SpaceVision 2026 conference at NASA’s Space Center Houston.
claims.episode_span: Twelve Tufts students joined the SpaceVision 2026 conference at NASA’s Space Center Houston where they met astronauts including Jim Wetherbee and Dan Burbank plus industry leaders working on rocketry clubs and lunar-lander design competitions.
claims.source_title: Tufts students join current, future space leaders at NASA’s Space Center Houston for SpaceVision conference
claims.supporting_quote: The conference drew students from around the world, including 12 from Tufts, to NASA’s Space Center Houston in early November for an exchange of ideas, experiences and inspiration.

claims.claim: ULA reported that low booster thrust on the November 15 launch resulted from inadequate fuel supply to the BE-4 engines.
claims.episode_span: United Launch Alliance reported that preliminary data from the November 15 Leo 1 launch show low booster thrust resulted from inadequate fuel supply to the BE-4 engines rather than engine performance itself.
claims.supporting_quote: low booster thrust was the result of inadequate fuel supply from the vehicle to the BE-4 engines
